product_metadata.title: Ivilon Drapery Curtain Clips with Rings - Set of 14 Decorative Drapery Rings Curtain Clip Rings with Strong Clips 2" Diameter - Color Pewter
features: This set includes 14 drapery curtain clip rings for fabric panels, curtains or draperies.
The inner diameter of the ring is 1.7", outer diameter 2", exact sizes in the images section.
Ivilon Drapery clips and rings are made of strong metal and they are easy and convenient to use.
Decorative and made of premium metal finished with a durable plating for long lasting.
Simply slide the curtain rings onto your rod and hang your drapery.
description: Ivilon rings comes in a variety of finishes and colors to hang draperies on any type of poles such as cafe rod or window curtain rods of every style. With the Ivilon rings you can hang any panels such as pinch pleats panels, French Drapes and more. Made of iron makes them strong and beautiful. Offered in 3 styles: loop, eyelet or clip Drapery pin hooks required for loop and eyelet rings.
